title: dactylorhiza × altobracensis
intro: Dactylorhiza × altobracensis, commonly known as the Altobrac hybrid orchid, is a rare and sterile interspecific hybrid between Dactylorhiza saccifera and Dactylorhiza maculata. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties, which may aid in the treatment of various ailments such as wounds and skin conditions. The therapeutic actions of Dactylorhiza × altobracensis include its ability to stimulate blood flow and reduce inflammation, making it a potential treatment for conditions such as varicose veins and phlebitis. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenes, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and contribute to its potential health benefits.
